# Test Fixtures

The first fixture set is defined by the vertical slice test saves:

- `VS-NEW-001`: before ACT-ROME-001.
- `VS-LEDGER-001`: before ACT-ROME-002 archive access.
- `VS-AUCTION-001`: before ACT-ROME-004 sale sequence.
- `VS-ESCAPE-001`: before ACT-ROME-005 diversion.
- `VS-REFUGE-001`: before ACT-ROME-006 resource allocation.
- `VS-FINALE-001`: before ACT-ROME-007 confrontation.

Fixtures must be versioned with the content manifest and must contain only deterministic state. Cosmetic random seeds may be included but cannot affect canonical outcomes.
